one_provider_active_visit.name: one_provider_active_visit
one_provider_active_visit.where: "bookings"."provider_id" is not null and ("bookings"."status" in ('on_the_way','inspecting','awaiting_approval','ready_to_start','in_progress') or ("bookings"."schedule_mode" = 'asap' and "bookings"."status" = 'accepted'))

booking_schedule_valid.name: booking_schedule_valid
booking_schedule_valid.value: "bookings"."schedule_mode" in ('legacy','scheduled','asap') and ("bookings"."schedule_mode" <> 'scheduled' or ("bookings"."preferred_time" is not null and "bookings"."preferred_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):(00|30)$')) and ("bookings"."schedule_mode" = 'scheduled' or "bookings"."preferred_time" is null) and "bookings"."visit_minutes" in (60,120,180,240,480)

booking_reservation_valid.name: booking_reservation_valid
booking_reservation_valid.value: ("bookings"."arrival_at" is null and "bookings"."reserved_until" is null and "bookings"."schedule_mode" = 'asap' and "bookings"."status" in ('requested','cancelled')) or ("bookings"."arrival_at" is not null and "bookings"."reserved_until" is not null and "bookings"."reserved_until" = "bookings"."arrival_at" + ("bookings"."visit_minutes" + 30) * interval '1 minute')

booking_assignment_valid.name: booking_assignment_valid
booking_assignment_valid.value: ("bookings"."status"::text = 'requested' and "bookings"."provider_id" is null) or ("bookings"."status"::text in ('accepted','on_the_way','inspecting','awaiting_approval','ready_to_start','in_progress','completed','inspection_completed') and "bookings"."provider_id" is not null) or "bookings"."status"::text = 'cancelled'

availability_day_or_date.name: availability_day_or_date
availability_day_or_date.value: ("provider_availability"."weekday" is not null and "provider_availability"."weekday" between 0 and 6 and "provider_availability"."date" is null) or ("provider_availability"."weekday" is null and "provider_availability"."date" is not null)
